extracted.intended_audience: researchers, scientists, innovators, educators, artists, and prospective or current Wellcome grant applicants/grantholders
extracted.subtask_description: Index and guidance page for Wellcome Trust grant schemes, application processes, and grant management topics — directs applicants and grantholders to specific schemes, deadlines, online systems, and topic-specific guidance. Useful for people seeking funding or needing advice on running or closing a Wellcome grant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Wellcome Early-Career Awards
rubrics_metrics.description: One of three new discovery research funding schemes launched under Wellcome's strategy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a targeted funding scheme; follow the linked scheme page for scheme-specific eligibility, scope, deadlines and application guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Wellcome Career Development Awards
rubrics_metrics.description: One of three new discovery research funding schemes launched under Wellcome's strategy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a targeted funding scheme; consult the scheme page for eligibility, assessment criteria, timelines and supporting documentation requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Wellcome Discovery Awards
rubrics_metrics.description: One of three new discovery research funding schemes launched under Wellcome's strategy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a targeted funding scheme; applicants should view the Discovery Awards page for details on remit, assessment expectations and application process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Find funding opportunities
rubrics_metrics.description: Top-level action to locate current Wellcome funding calls and schemes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the 'Find funding opportunities' functionality to identify appropriate schemes and active calls; follow links to scheme pages for full criteria and application instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: View all our funding schemes
rubrics_metrics.description: A consolidated list of Wellcome funding schemes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides navigation to every scheme offered by Wellcome; each scheme page will contain specific eligibility, assessment and application requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: See a list of our scheme deadlines
rubrics_metrics.description: A page listing upcoming deadlines for Wellcome funding schemes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check scheme deadlines to plan applications; missing a published deadline may prevent submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grant Tracker (Apply for a grant or manage an existing one)
rubrics_metrics.description: The online system used to submit applications and manage awarded grants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants and grantholders must log in to Grant Tracker to apply, submit documents, manage reporting and administration. Follow system prompts and guidance for submissions and grant management tasks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applying for funding (funding guidance topic)
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance support for people needing help or advice with applying for funding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page links to detailed guidance on application preparation, eligibility, required documentation, and how to use Grant Tracker; applicants should consult these resources to maximise compliance with scheme requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Starting a grant (funding guidance topic)
rubrics_metrics.description: Advice and requirements for initiating a Wellcome-funded project once awarded.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers practical steps and institutional responsibilities at grant start; consult for required paperwork, approvals, and induction of project activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grant finance and administration (funding guidance topic)
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on financial management and administrative responsibilities for Wellcome grants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes information on allowable costs, budgeting, financial reporting, and administrative processes; follow to ensure compliant use of funds and correct reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research practice and policies (funding guidance topic)
rubrics_metrics.description: Wellcome's expectations and policies regarding research conduct and integrity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers policies on research governance, ethics, data management, open research, and responsible conduct; applicants and grantholders must follow these policies as part of grant conditions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ending a grant (funding guidance topic)
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on closing out a Wellcome-funded project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains final reporting, data and outputs handover, financial reconciliation and any continuing obligations after grant end.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research outputs (funding guidance topic)
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance about publishing and otherwise sharing research outputs from Wellcome-funded work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides expectations for open access, data sharing, reporting outputs and how to acknowledge Wellcome funding; follow to meet dissemination obligations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coronavirus (Covid-19) — What you need to know if you're a grant applicant or grantholder
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific guidance related to Covid-19 for applicants and current grantholders.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contains advice and any temporary policy changes or flexibilities related to the pandemic that affect applications, project delivery or reporting; consult when Covid-19 impacts proposals or active grants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Find out about grants we've awarded
rubrics_metrics.description: Portal to information on people and projects funded by Wellcome.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes searchable records of awarded grants, researcher stories and funding data; useful for benchmarking, finding similar projects, and understanding Wellcome's funding priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grants awarded (information resource)
rubrics_metrics.description: Page or section listing specific grants Wellcome has awarded.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use to see example funded projects, funding amounts and durations; helpful when assessing alignment of a proposal with Wellcome priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Researcher stories
rubrics_metrics.description: Narrative case studies of funded researchers and projects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides qualitative examples of funded work and impacts; useful for understanding the kinds of projects Wellcome highlights and values.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grant funding data
rubrics_metrics.description: Data resource on Wellcome's grant awards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Offers structured data about funding distributions and recipients; can inform strategic decisions about applying or demonstrating alignment with Wellcome's portfolio.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sign up to our research newsletter
rubrics_metrics.description: Subscription call to receive updates on funding news, policy changes and events.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recommended for staying informed about new funding opportunities, deadlines and policy updates relevant to applicants and grantholders.
